description:
Position: WEB UI Developer
Location : Charlotte, NC
Duration : 18 months+ 
 
 Skills:- 
Extensive experience in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, GIT, Eclipse Sublime Text 2, Windows and OS X required. 
 Must have experience in recent projects on any one or more of the following frameworks:- Handbrake-js, Ember, or Angularjs required.
Experience in REST / mobile services is a big plus.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in development using technologies listed above.
Enjoy working in Agile / Scrum environments.
Proven talent for solving challenging problems.
The candidate is required to possess excellent oral and written communications skills.
